ablation.aggregation: fitting seeds averaged within outer fold, then outer-fold mean and SD; within-fold seed SD reported separately
ablation.commands: python -m experiments.make_revision.extra_ablation prepare|ablation --protocol <frozen protocol> --reference <run> --output <ablation>; python -m experiments.make_revision.extra_ablation summary --output <ablation>
ablation.dataset_loading: the prepared data are copied from the run; in production every dataset is reloaded through its pinned extra_data loader and must equal the run's prepared features (NaN equal to NaN) and labels, with the pinned dataset and splits hashes

depth_split.definition: per dataset, untrained minus views7 accuracy (fitting seeds averaged within fold), grouped by the hidden widths of the reconstructed selection; per group the folds, n, mean, SD, min, max and the corrected resampled t interval over the group's folds when n >= 2; pooled across datasets per group: n, mean and SD

dropped_variants.borda_views7: Borda view aggregation is not defined for the kNN readout
dropped_variants.multiview_footrule_knn: replaced by input_knn, whose readout is tuned inside every fit exactly as ArrowFlow-kNN tunes its own
dropped_variants.single_view_no_checkpoint_no_augment: not among the variants of the Task 20B ruling

ablation.failure_policy: log_all_failures; a failed variant fit leaves an explicit failed row; failed jobs are never omitted from the summary; no adaptive stopping on any score; a views7 reproduction failure is an integrity failure: its job fails, the pending jobs are cancelled and the summary refuses
ablation.fit_reuse: views7 is fitted once per seed and fold; views1 and views3 are majorities over its first one and three per-view kNN votes (view v depends only on derive_seed(seed, "view", v)); prototype_readout is the majority of the output rule of the same seven trained networks; no_checkpoint and no_augment are fitted separately unless their parameters coincide with views7 (no_augment where the resolved augment is already false), in which case the record says identical_to_views7; untrained and input_knn are fitted separately and train nothing; reused fits carry zero timings and name their source fit

knn_readout.selection: mean accuracy over StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=derive_seed(view_seed, "readout_selection")) splits of the training partition inside every fit; fewer splits only if the smallest class has fewer rows; one neighbour cache per split at the largest k; ties lowest_canonical_config_id; refit on the full training representation

ablation.parallelism: spawned single-thread process per dataset and outer fold under the shared execution lock
ablation.reference: the artificial run of this protocol (arrowflow_full_knn): its protocol.json must be byte-identical to the committed frozen protocol and its summary.json complete; the run's protocol sha256, summary sha256 and code revision are sealed in the ablation manifest at prepare and re-checked at summary

reporting.change_from_views7: per dataset and variant, variant minus views7 in accuracy and error: fitting seeds averaged within outer fold, corrected resampled t interval over the 15 outer folds (q = test_train_ratio, 14 df); descriptive; no p values; no Holm adjustment
reporting.outputs: artificial_ablation_summary.json (metrics, intervals, depth split, reproduction counts, model rows) and artificial_ablation_summary.csv (metrics per dataset, variant and metric)

ablation.reproduction: views7 must reproduce the outer predictions of the run exactly for every dataset, outer fold and fitting seed (the same labels in the sealed test-sample order); checked inside every job, again for every record by the summary, and every sealed selection is re-derived from the run at summary time
ablation.selected_configuration: results/<dataset>__arrowflow_full_knn__r<repeat>f<fold>.json selection block of the run, reconstructed from the complete inner fit history at prepare time (reporting.validate_result_records) and resolved to embed_dim, degree and augment from the outer training partition shape (bridge.resolve_selected); sealed in reference_selected_configurations.csv and reference_selections.json with the reference per-example predictions
ablation.shared_design: confidence, fit_seeds, historical_results, inner_folds, numeric_threads_per_worker, outer_folds, outer_repeats, report_metrics, selection_metric, split_seed and test_train_ratio are the protocol's top-level values (equal in both templates)

variant_definitions.input_knn: the same seven encoders with the kNN readout tuned on the encoded input positions (knn_controls.MultiViewInputKNN)
variant_definitions.no_augment: augment false; kNN readout; identical_to_views7 where the resolved augment is already false
variant_definitions.no_checkpoint: validation_ratio 0: networks trained on all training rows without the validation checkpoint; kNN readout
variant_definitions.prototype_readout: the output rule of the same seven trained networks (ArrowFlowEstimator.predict_orders per view), majority vote; derived from the views7 fit without retraining
variant_definitions.untrained: the selected widths, embed_dim, degree and seeds with every network at its seeded initial filters and the same kNN readout selection (knn_controls.UntrainedMultiViewArrowFlowKNN)
variant_definitions.views1: n_views 1: the first per-view kNN vote of views7 (what MultiViewArrowFlowKNN with n_views 1 predicts)
variant_definitions.views3: n_views 3: the majority of the first three per-view kNN votes of views7
variant_definitions.views7: ArrowFlow-kNN (MultiViewArrowFlowKNN, seven views) at the reconstructed selection; must reproduce the reference outer predictions exactly

comparator_intervals.definition: per dataset and comparator, arrowflow_full_knn minus the comparator accuracy: fitting seeds averaged within each outer fold; corrected resampled t over the outer folds (evaluation.paired_corrected_interval, q = test_train_ratio = 0.25, 95%, df = outer folds - 1 = 14); two-sided p, unadjusted (compare_newdata.comparator_rows); the comparator with the lowest mean outer error is flagged

competitiveness.definition: holistic.competitiveness on the mean outer errors of ArrowFlow-kNN, the five tuned classical models and the majority class: the best tuned model, the gap, within three points, best-on, ceiling, near-majority and no-learning

rules.best_classical: the tuned classical model (svc_rbf, random_forest, mlp, numeric_knn, gradient_boosting; the majority class excluded) with the lowest mean outer error; every model tied at that minimum is listed
rules.best_on: ArrowFlow mean error strictly below the mean error of every tuned classical model (gap_points < 0)
rules.ceiling: the best tuned classical mean error is below 1.0 point
rules.gap_points: ArrowFlow mean error minus the best tuned classical mean error; positive when ArrowFlow trails
rules.near_majority: ArrowFlow mean error within 0.5 points (absolute difference, inclusive) of the majority-class mean error, while the best tuned classical model is at least 2.0 points better than ArrowFlow (gap_points >= 2.0)
rules.no_learning: the majority class has the lowest mean error of all models: no model among ArrowFlow and the five tuned classical models has a strictly lower mean error than the majority class
rules.unit: percentage points of mean outer error (the summary.json mean times 100), rounded to 9 decimals before any comparison so that binary floating-point noise cannot move a flag
rules.within_three_points_as_printed: the same rule on the gap printed with two decimals (gap_points_2dp) and on the gap of the two errors printed with one decimal (gap_points_from_1dp_errors); true only if both agree with within_three_points, so a count never contradicts a printed value

complete_metrics.definition: per dataset and model, each metric's mean, outer-fold SD and within-fold seed SD (holistic.complete_metric_rows)

components.definition: per dataset and variant, ArrowFlow (views7, which reproduces the run's outer predictions exactly) minus the variant, accuracy, in points beside the fraction: the ablation summary's change_from_views7 accuracy interval negated with its bounds swapped (holistic.component_rows), with the outer folds in which the variant is identical to views7 by construction
components.status: descriptive; no p values; no multiplicity adjustment

duplicate_audit.definition: exact duplicate feature rows of the prepared data (extra_data.duplicate_groups: float64 equality of every feature, NaN equal to NaN; equal to referee_analyses.duplicate_groups on data without NaN): rows, distinct rows, duplicate rows, duplicate groups, label-conflicting groups and the largest group; per outer fold the test rows with an exact duplicate in the training partition

analysis.ladder_table: per dataset, mean outer error, outer-fold SD (ddof 1) and mean within-fold seed SD of every rung (compare_newdata.ladder_rows)

main_table.definition: per dataset, mean outer error (the mean over outer folds of the fitting-seed-averaged error), outer-fold SD (ddof 1) and mean within-fold seed SD of ArrowFlow-kNN, the five tuned classical models and the majority class, from the verified summary.json

notes.descriptive_only: ranks8_original (77 rows) is reported descriptively and belongs to no family
notes.features: each item's relative position, NaN for a deleted item; every model imputes missing cells fold-locally
notes.low_power: each family holds two datasets, so Holm adjusts over two
notes.not_pooled: the artificial datasets are not pooled into the seventeen-dataset Friedman analysis

primary_family.definition: per family dataset, arrowflow_full_knn minus arrowflow_knn_untrained accuracy (the training effect)
primary_family.interval: fitting seeds averaged within each outer fold; corrected resampled t over the outer folds (evaluation.paired_corrected_interval, q = test_train_ratio = 0.25, 95%, df = outer folds - 1 = 14); two-sided p

secondary_family.definition: per family dataset, arrowflow_full_knn minus input_footrule_knn accuracy
secondary_family.interval: fitting seeds averaged within each outer fold; corrected resampled t over the outer folds (evaluation.paired_corrected_interval, q = test_train_ratio = 0.25, 95%, df = outer folds - 1 = 14); two-sided p
secondary_family.multiplicity: Holm across the 2 family datasets (evaluation.holm_adjust), adjusted separately from the primary family

selected_widths.definition: the hidden widths of the configuration arrowflow_full_knn selected on the inner folds of each outer fold (knn_controls.selected_widths on the verified outer model rows)

analysis.status: prespecified before any outer score on these datasets exists; computed only by compare_extra analyse, which refuses (exit 2, nothing written) until the run and its component ablation are complete, then re-verifies both before any score is read

design_source.ablation_identical_to_template: aggregation, depth_split, dropped_variants, failure_policy, fit_reuse, max_workers, parallelism, variant_definitions, variants
design_source.ablation_shared_with_the_run_design: confidence, fit_seeds, historical_results, inner_folds, numeric_threads_per_worker, outer_folds, outer_repeats, report_metrics, selection_metric, split_seed, test_train_ratio
design_source.changed: protocol_id, production_family, registry, datasets, panel, primary_family_size, secondary_family_size, multiplicity, analysis, selection_ruling, wallclock_cap_hours, frozen, status, resource_decision
design_source.identical_to_template: aggregation_integrity, augmentation, candidate_budget, candidate_seed, candidate_tie_rule, confidence, device, failure_policy, fit_seeds, freeze_requirement, full_method, historical_results, inner_folds, internal_validation_ratio, numeric_threads_per_worker, outer_folds, outer_repeats, paired_interval, parallelism, report_metrics, selection_metric, split_seed, stochastic_finalists, test_train_ratio, model_order, models, primary_contrasts, secondary_contrasts

removed_from_template.model_template_sha256: the model declarations are copied from the template itself

full_method.resolution: embed_dim=clip(round(base*embed_scale),8,128); degree=max(1,base+degree_offset) lowered while comb(n_features+degree,degree)>10000; augment=base_augment and n_train>=150; resolved at fit time from the training partition only

arrowflow_full_knn.network: seven views trained with full_method.fixed (checkpoint validation_ratio 0.1) and the augmentation rule; each view reseeds from derive_seed(fit seed, "view", v)

readout.representation: inverse positions of the final hidden ranking of each view
readout.selection: mean accuracy over StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=derive_seed(view_seed, "readout_selection")) splits of the training partition inside every fit; ties lowest_canonical_config_id; refit on the full training representation

arrowflow_full_knn.template: bridge_knn.json knn_readout without its reference block

gradient_boosting.estimator: comparisons.conventional_factory (NumericImputer, StandardScaler for svc_rbf, mlp and numeric_knn, classifier)

mlp.estimator: comparisons.conventional_factory (NumericImputer, StandardScaler for svc_rbf, mlp and numeric_knn, classifier)

numeric_knn.estimator: comparisons.conventional_factory (NumericImputer, StandardScaler for svc_rbf, mlp and numeric_knn, classifier)

random_forest.estimator: comparisons.conventional_factory (NumericImputer, StandardScaler for svc_rbf, mlp and numeric_knn, classifier)

svc_rbf.estimator: comparisons.conventional_factory (NumericImputer, StandardScaler for svc_rbf, mlp and numeric_knn, classifier)

multiplicity: Holm_across_the_2_family_datasets_within_each_family; the primary and secondary families are adjusted separately

projection.assumptions: the calibration factors were measured under 16 single-thread workers of the bridge_knn and knn_training production runs and are applied at this family's workers; other families running at the same time add contention the factors do not hold; the ablation jobs take their fold's three seeds in sequence
projection.decision: calibrated central simulated makespan at 16 workers of the run jobs plus the ablation jobs plus 0.25 h of stage overhead (prepare, reporting, ablation prepare and summary, analysis)
